name: Eleonora of Arborea Issues Carta de Logu
summary: Eleonora of Arborea, ruling judge of the Giudicato of Arborea, issued the Carta de Logu, a comprehensive law code covering civil and criminal law, protecting women's rights and property. It remained in force in Sardinia until 1827 and is the most important monument of medieval Sardinian governance.
